verdict.rationale: PostHog documents a free hosted MCP server that runs trends, funnels, retention, and SQL/HogQL queries from any MCP client, including a scopable execute-sql tool. It also documents a programmatic /query API endpoint for HogQL and a CLI that agents can use for SQL queries. A probe confirms the MCP endpoint is live and OAuth-gated with granular scopes. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of agents answering growth questions via MCP/API; the semantic-layer governed metrics are still beta.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent answer growth questions from live product data by running queries through the API or MCP server

citations.quote: Run trends, funnels, retention, and SQL queries from any MCP client or AI editor.
To create a query, you make a `POST` request to the `/api/projects/:project_id/query/` endpoint
Use `posthog-cli api` to access PostHog's API and MCP tool catalog from shell-friendly commands, including running SQL queries against your data
